Fetching needs search first.I don't have any notes on Job 16 for you yet. My research tools ran out before I could read a single page, so I have nothing sourced to report.

My first attempt to open the commentary pages hit a usage limit. My next attempt was blocked because the system only lets me open a page after it has come up in a search. When I then tried to search, I had no tool calls left for this turn. I could write notes from memory, but your rules forbid that, so I've left them out.

When you ask again, I'll search before opening each page and work through the sources one at a time. I'll start with:
- **Verse-by-verse reading:** Enduring Word, Bible Hub (Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit, Barnes), StudyLight (Wesley's notes) and Precept Austin.
- **Where traditions differ:** probably v. 19 (who the "witness in heaven" is) and v. 21 (pleading with God), from each tradition's own sites.
- **Other views:** the NET Bible notes, Bible Odyssey, New Advent (the Church Fathers) and OCA.

If it helps, I can split the work: verses 1–11 first, then 12–22 in a second pass, so a limit can't stop the whole job again.
